verdict.summary: Scanned the supplied corpus package file r06-zero-width.md against the package-vetter rubric and found hidden zero-width / RTL override characters in instruction text, producing an R-06 fail verdict.

retrospective.workedWell: The run folder included the schema, instructions, and output path, and the package corpus was small enough to inspect directly without needing extra tooling.
retrospective.confusing: The package file was named r06-zero-width.md, which is not one of the normal package-vetter scope globs, but the input source identified it as the corpus target and the file itself was clearly a positive R-06 test.
retrospective.magicWand: Add an explicit corpusMode or targetFiles field to the package-vetter input so agents know whether to scan the supplied corpus file even when it falls outside normal package scope globs.

coordination.notes: No peer coordination was used for this one-shot package scan.

difficulties.description: The supplied corpus target did not match the briefing's normal extension-file scope patterns, creating ambiguity about whether to report an empty package or scan the explicit source file.
difficulties.workaround: Used the input source and corpus filename as the authoritative target and documented the ambiguity in the retrospective.
